verses.original: בִּשְׁנַת־ שֶׁ֤בַע לְיֵהוּא֙ מָלַ֣ךְ יְהוֹאָ֔שׁ וְאַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ צִבְיָ֖ה מִבְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ- še·ḇa‘ lə·yê·hū mā·laḵ yə·hō·w·’āš wə·’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·šêm ’im·mōw ṣiḇ·yāh mib·bə·’êr šā·ḇa‘
verses.literal: In the seventh year of Jehu Joash became king and he reigned in Jerusalem forty years His mother’s name was Zibiah she was from Beersheba
verses.literalPt: No sétimo ano de Jeú, começou Joás a reinar e reinou quarenta anos em Jerusalém. A sua mãe chamava-se Zíbia, de Berseba.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ יְהוֹאָ֧שׁ הַיָּשָׁ֛ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה כָּל־ יָמָ֑יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹרָ֔הוּ יְהוֹיָדָ֖ע הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś yə·hō·w·’āš hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh kāl- yā·māw ’ă·šer hō·w·rā·hū yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: And Joash did what was right in the eyes of the LORD all the days he was instructed by Jehoiada the priest
verses.literalPt: Fez Joás o que era reto aos olhos de Jeová todo o tempo em que Joiada, o sacerdote, o instruiu.

verses.original: רַ֥ק הַבָּמ֖וֹת לֹא־ סָ֑רוּ ע֥וֹד הָעָ֛ם מְזַבְּחִ֥ים וּֽמְקַטְּרִ֖ים בַּבָּמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: raq hab·bā·mō·wṯ lō- sā·rū ‘ō·wḏ hā·‘ām mə·zab·bə·ḥîm ū·mə·qaṭ·ṭə·rîm bab·bā·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: Nevertheless the high places were not removed the people continued sacrificing and burning incense there
verses.literalPt: Todavia, não foram tirados os altos; o povo ainda oferecia sacrifícios e queimava incenso nos altos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹאָ֜שׁ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים כֹּל֩ כֶּ֨סֶף הַקֳּדָשִׁ֜ים אֲשֶׁר־ יוּבָ֤א בֵית־ יְהוָה֙ כֶּ֣סֶף עוֹבֵ֔ר אִ֕ישׁ כֶּ֥סֶף נַפְשׁ֖וֹת עֶרְכּ֑וֹ כָּל־ כֶּ֗סֶף אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַֽעֲלֶה֙ עַ֣ל לֶב־ אִ֔ישׁ לְהָבִ֖יא בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hō·w·’āš ’el- hak·kō·hă·nîm kōl ke·sep̄ haq·qo·ḏā·šîm ’ă·šer- yū·ḇā ḇêṯ- Yah·weh ke·sep̄ ‘ō·w·ḇêr ’îš ke·sep̄ nap̄·šō·wṯ ‘er·kōw kāl- ke·sep̄ ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·leh ‘al leḇ- ’îš lə·hā·ḇî bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then Joash said to the priests Collect all the money brought as sacred gifts into the house of the LORD the census . . . money the money from vows . . . and the money brought voluntarily . . . . . . . . . into the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Disse Joás aos sacerdotes: Todo o dinheiro das coisas consagradas que for trazido à Casa de Jeová, em moeda corrente, o dinheiro das pessoas para quem se fizer avaliação e todo o dinheiro que alguém resolver no seu coração trazer à Casa de Jeová,

verses.original: יִקְח֤וּ לָהֶם֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים אִ֖ישׁ מֵאֵ֣ת מַכָּר֑וֹ וְהֵ֗ם יְחַזְּקוּ֙ אֶת־ בֶּ֣דֶק הַבַּ֔יִת לְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִמָּצֵ֥א שָׁ֖ם בָּֽדֶק׃פ
verses.transliteration: yiq·ḥū lā·hem hak·kō·hă·nîm ’îš mê·’êṯ mak·kā·rōw wə·hêm yə·ḥaz·zə·qū ’eṯ- be·ḏeq hab·ba·yiṯ lə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- yim·mā·ṣê šām bā·ḏeq
verses.literal: Let every . . . priest receive it from his constituency and let it be used to repair any damage . . . found in the temple . . .
verses.literalPt: recebam-no os sacerdotes, cada um das mãos dos seus conhecidos. Repararão eles os estragos da casa, onde quer que se encontrar qualquer estrago.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּשְׁנַ֨ת עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וְשָׁלֹ֛שׁ שָׁנָ֖ה לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יְהוֹאָ֑שׁ לֹֽא־ חִזְּק֥וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים אֶת־ בֶּ֥דֶק הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî biš·naṯ ‘eś·rîm wə·šā·lōš šā·nāh lam·me·leḵ yə·hō·w·’āš lō- ḥiz·zə·qū hak·kō·hă·nîm ’eṯ- be·ḏeq hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: By the twenty-third . . . . . . year of the reign of Joash however the priests had not yet repaired the damage to the temple
verses.literalPt: Sucedeu, porém, que, no ano vigésimo terceiro do rei Joás, os sacerdotes ainda não tinham reparado os estragos da casa.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָא֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ יְהוֹאָ֜שׁ לִיהוֹיָדָ֤ע הַכֹּהֵן֙ וְלַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם מַדּ֛וּעַ אֵינְכֶ֥ם מְחַזְּקִ֖ים אֶת־ בֶּ֣דֶק הַבָּ֑יִת וְעַתָּ֗ה אַל־ תִּקְחוּ־ כֶ֙סֶף֙ מֵאֵ֣ת מַכָּֽרֵיכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ לְבֶ֥דֶק הַבַּ֖יִת תִּתְּנֻֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ham·me·leḵ yə·hō·w·’āš lî·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ hak·kō·hên wə·lak·kō·hă·nîm way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem mad·dū·a‘ ’ê·nə·ḵem mə·ḥaz·zə·qîm ’eṯ- be·ḏeq hab·bā·yiṯ wə·‘at·tāh ’al- tiq·ḥū- ḵe·sep̄ mê·’êṯ mak·kā·rê·ḵem kî- lə·ḇe·ḏeq hab·ba·yiṯ tit·tə·nu·hū
verses.literal: So King Joash called Jehoiada and the other priests and said . . . Why have you not repaired the damage to the temple Now, therefore take no more money from your constituency but hand it over for the repair of the temple
verses.literalPt: Então, o rei Joás chamou ao sacerdote Joiada e os mais sacerdotes e lhes disse: Por que não reparais os estragos da casa? Agora, não recebais mais dinheiro das mãos dos vossos conhecidos, mas entregai-o para os reparos dos estragos da casa.

verses.original: וַיֵּאֹ֖תוּ הַכֹּֽהֲנִ֑ים לְבִלְתִּ֤י קְחַת־ כֶּ֙סֶף֙ מֵאֵ֣ת הָעָ֔ם וּלְבִלְתִּ֥י חַזֵּ֖ק אֶת־ בֶּ֥דֶק הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·’ō·ṯū hak·kō·hă·nîm lə·ḇil·tî qə·ḥaṯ- ke·sep̄ mê·’êṯ hā·‘ām ū·lə·ḇil·tî ḥaz·zêq ’eṯ- be·ḏeq hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: So the priests agreed that they would not receive money from the people and that they would not repair the temple themselves
verses.literalPt: Consentiram os sacerdotes em não receberem mais dinheiro do povo, nem em repararem os estragos da casa.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח יְהוֹיָדָ֤ע הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֲר֣וֹן אֶחָ֔ד וַיִּקֹּ֥ב חֹ֖ר בְּדַלְתּ֑וֹ וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֹתוֹ֩ אֵ֨צֶל הַמִּזְבֵּ֜חַ בַּיָּמִין בְּבֽוֹא־ אִישׁ֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְנָֽתְנוּ־ שָׁ֤מָּה הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ שֹׁמְרֵ֣י הַסַּ֔ף אֶת־ כָּל־ הַכֶּ֖סֶף הַמּוּבָ֥א בֵית־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ hak·kō·hên ’ă·rō·wn ’e·ḥāḏ way·yiq·qōḇ ḥōr bə·ḏal·tōw way·yit·tên ’ō·ṯōw ’ê·ṣel ham·miz·bê·aḥ bay·yå̄·mīn bə·ḇō·w- ’îš bêṯ Yah·weh wə·nā·ṯə·nū- šām·māh hak·kō·hă·nîm šō·mə·rê has·sap̄ ’eṯ- kāl- hak·ke·sep̄ ham·mū·ḇā ḇêṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then Jehoiada the priest took a chest bored a hole in its lid and set it beside the altar on the right side as one enters the house of the LORD There the priests who guarded the threshold put all the money brought into the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Mas o sacerdote Joiada tomou uma caixa, fez-lhe um buraco na tampa e pô-la junto ao altar, à direita de quem entra na Casa de Jeová. Os sacerdotes que guardavam a porta deitavam ali todo o dinheiro que se trazia à Casa de Jeová.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּרְאוֹתָ֔ם כִּֽי־ רַ֥ב הַכֶּ֖סֶף בָּֽאָר֑וֹן וַיַּ֨עַל סֹפֵ֤ר הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְהַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֔וֹל וַיָּצֻ֙רוּ֙ וַיִּמְנ֔וּ אֶת־ הַכֶּ֖סֶף הַנִּמְצָ֥א בֵית־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kir·’ō·w·ṯām kî- raḇ hak·ke·sep̄ bā·’ā·rō·wn way·ya·‘al sō·p̄êr ham·me·leḵ wə·hak·kō·hên hag·gā·ḏō·wl way·yā·ṣu·rū way·yim·nū ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ han·nim·ṣā ḇêṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Whenever they saw that there was a large amount of money in the chest the royal scribe and the high priest would go up count the money brought into the house of the LORD and tie it up in bags
verses.literalPt: Quando viam que havia muito dinheiro na caixa, vinham o escrivão do rei e o sumo sacerdote, e ensacavam, e contavam o dinheiro que se achava na Casa de Jeová.

verses.original: וְנָתְנוּ֙ אֶת־ הַכֶּ֣סֶף הַֽמְתֻכָּ֔ן עַל־ יַד עֹשֵׂ֣י הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה הַפְּקֻדִים בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיּוֹצִיאֻ֜הוּ לְחָרָשֵׁ֤י הָעֵץ֙ וְלַבֹּנִ֔ים הָעֹשִׂ֖ים בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯə·nū ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ ham·ṯuk·kān ‘al- yaḏ ‘ō·śê ham·mə·lā·ḵāh hap·pə·qu·ḏīm bêṯ Yah·weh way·yō·w·ṣî·’u·hū lə·ḥā·rā·šê hā·‘êṣ wə·lab·bō·nîm hā·‘ō·śîm bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then they would put the counted money into the hands of those who supervised the work on the house of the LORD who in turn would pay those doing the work - the carpenters . . . builders
verses.literalPt: Punham o dinheiro, depois de pesado, nas mãos dos que faziam a obra e que tinham a seu cargo a Casa de Jeová; estes o despendiam com os carpinteiros, e com os edificadores que trabalhavam na Casa de Jeová,

verses.original: וְלַגֹּֽדְרִים֙ וּלְחֹצְבֵ֣י הָאֶ֔בֶן וְלִקְנ֤וֹת עֵצִים֙ וְאַבְנֵ֣י מַחְצֵ֔ב לְחַזֵּ֖ק אֶת־ בֶּ֣דֶק בֵּית־ יְהוָ֑ה וּלְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יֵצֵ֥א עַל־ הַבַּ֖יִת לְחָזְקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lag·gō·ḏə·rîm ū·lə·ḥō·ṣə·ḇê hā·’e·ḇen wə·liq·nō·wṯ ‘ê·ṣîm wə·’aḇ·nê maḥ·ṣêḇ lə·ḥaz·zêq ’eṯ- be·ḏeq bêṯ- Yah·weh ū·lə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- yê·ṣê ‘al- hab·ba·yiṯ lə·ḥā·zə·qāh
verses.literal: masons and stonecutters . . . They also purchased timber and dressed stone to repair the damage to the house of the LORD and they paid the other expenses of the temple repairs
verses.literalPt: e com os pedreiros, e com os que cortavam as pedras de cantaria e para comprarem as madeiras e pedras de cantaria, a fim de repararem os estragos da Casa de Jeová, e com tudo o que se gastava para se reparar a casa.

verses.original: אַךְ֩ לֹ֨א יֵעָשֶׂ֜ה בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֗ה סִפּ֥וֹת כֶּ֙סֶף֙ מְזַמְּר֤וֹת מִזְרָקוֹת֙ חֲצֹ֣צְר֔וֹת כָּל־ כְּלִ֥י זָהָ֖ב וּכְלִי־ כָ֑סֶף מִן־ הַכֶּ֖סֶף הַמּוּבָ֥א בֵית־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ lō yê·‘ā·śeh bêṯ Yah·weh sip·pō·wṯ ke·sep̄ mə·zam·mə·rō·wṯ miz·rā·qō·wṯ ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ kāl- kə·lî zā·hāḇ ū·ḵə·lî- ḵā·sep̄ min- hak·ke·sep̄ ham·mū·ḇā ḇêṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: However the money brought into the house of the LORD was not used for making silver basins wick trimmers sprinkling bowls trumpets or any articles of gold . . . or silver for the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Mas, do dinheiro que se trazia à Casa de Jeová, não foram feitos nem taças de prata, nem espevitadeiras, nem bacias, nem trombetas, nenhum vaso de ouro ou vaso de prata, para a Casa de Jeová,

verses.original: כִּֽי־ לְעֹשֵׂ֥י הַמְּלָאכָ֖ה יִתְּנֻ֑הוּ וְחִזְּקוּ־ ב֖וֹ אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- lə·‘ō·śê ham·mə·lā·ḵāh yit·tə·nu·hū wə·ḥiz·zə·qū- ḇōw ’eṯ- bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Instead it was paid to those doing the work and with it they repaired the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: porque o davam aos que faziam a obra, reparando com ele a Casa de Jeová.

verses.original: וְלֹ֧א יְחַשְּׁב֣וּ אֶת־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתְּנ֤וּ אֶת־ הַכֶּ֙סֶף֙ עַל־ יָדָ֔ם לָתֵ֖ת לְעֹשֵׂ֣י הַמְּלָאכָ֑ה כִּ֥י בֶאֱמֻנָ֖ה הֵ֥ם עֹשִֽׂים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō yə·ḥaš·šə·ḇū ’eṯ- hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer yit·tə·nū ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ ‘al- yā·ḏām lā·ṯêṯ lə·‘ō·śê ham·mə·lā·ḵāh kî ḇe·’ĕ·mu·nāh hêm ‘ō·śîm
verses.literal: No accounting was required . . . from the men who received the money . . . . . . . . . to pay the workmen . . . because they acted with integrity
verses.literalPt: Não se tomava conta aos homens em cujas mãos entregavam o dinheiro para o distribuir pelos que faziam a obra; porque eles se haviam com fidelidade.

verses.original: כֶּ֤סֶף אָשָׁם֙ וְכֶ֣סֶף חַטָּא֔וֹת לֹ֥א יוּבָ֖א בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים יִהְיֽוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ke·sep̄ ’ā·šām wə·ḵe·sep̄ ḥaṭ·ṭā·’ō·wṯ lō yū·ḇā bêṯ Yah·weh lak·kō·hă·nîm yih·yū
verses.literal: The money from the guilt offerings . . . and sin offerings was not brought into the house of the LORD it belonged to the priests
verses.literalPt: O dinheiro para as ofertas pela culpa, e o dinheiro para as ofertas pelo pecado não era trazido à Casa de Jeová; era dos sacerdotes.

verses.original: אָ֣ז יַעֲלֶ֗ה חֲזָאֵל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם וַיִּלָּ֥חֶם עַל־ גַּ֖ת וַֽיִּלְכְּדָ֑הּ וַיָּ֤שֶׂם חֲזָאֵל֙ פָּנָ֔יו לַעֲל֖וֹת עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz ya·‘ă·leh ḥă·zā·’êl me·leḵ ’ă·rām way·yil·lā·ḥem ‘al- gaṯ way·yil·kə·ḏāh way·yā·śem ḥă·zā·’êl pā·nāw la·‘ă·lō·wṯ ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: At that time Hazael king of Aram marched up and fought against Gath and captured it Then he decided . . . to attack . . . Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Então, subiu Hazael, rei da Síria, pelejou contra Gate e a tomou; e fez rosto para marchar contra Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח יְהוֹאָ֣שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֗ה אֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֡ים אֲשֶׁר־ הִקְדִּ֣ישׁוּ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט וִיהוֹרָם֩ וַאֲחַזְיָ֨הוּ אֲבֹתָ֜יו מַלְכֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וְאֶת־ קֳדָשָׁ֔יו וְאֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַזָּהָ֗ב הַנִּמְצָ֛א בְּאֹצְר֥וֹת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה וּבֵ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח לַֽחֲזָאֵל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם וַיַּ֖עַל מֵעַ֥ל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ yə·hō·w·’āš me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh ’êṯ kāl- haq·qo·ḏā·šîm ’ă·šer- hiq·dî·šū yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ wî·hō·w·rām wa·’ă·ḥaz·yā·hū ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’eṯ- qo·ḏā·šāw wə·’êṯ kāl- haz·zā·hāḇ han·nim·ṣā bə·’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ bêṯ- Yah·weh ū·ḇêṯ ham·me·leḵ way·yiš·laḥ la·ḥă·zā·’êl me·leḵ ’ă·rām way·ya·‘al mê·‘al yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: So King Joash of Judah took all the sacred objects dedicated by his fathers Jehoshaphat Jehoram and Ahaziah the kings of Judah along with his own consecrated items and all the gold found in the treasuries of the house of the LORD and the royal palace and he sent them to Hazael king of Aram So Hazael withdrew from Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Joás, rei de Judá, tomou todas as coisas consagradas que Josafá, Jeorão e Acazias, seus pais, reis de Judá, tinham dedicado, e tudo o que ele mesmo tinha oferecido, e todo o ouro que se achava nos tesouros da Casa de Jeová e da casa do rei e o enviou a Hazael, rei da Síria; e este se retirou de Jerusalém.

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יוֹאָ֖שׁ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלוֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê yō·w·’āš wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hă·lō·w- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Joash along with all his accomplishments . . . . . . . . . are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Judah
verses.literalPt: Ora, o restante dos atos de Joás e tudo o que ele fez não estão, porventura, escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Judá?

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֥מוּ עֲבָדָ֖יו וַיִּקְשְׁרֽוּ־ קָ֑שֶׁר וַיַּכּוּ֙ אֶת־ יוֹאָ֔שׁ בֵּ֥ית מִלֹּ֖א הַיּוֹרֵ֥ד סִלָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qu·mū ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw way·yiq·šə·rū- qā·šer way·yak·kū ’eṯ- yō·w·’āš bêṯ mil·lō hay·yō·w·rêḏ sil·lā
verses.literal: And the servants of Joash rose up and formed a conspiracy and killed him . . . at Beth-millo on the road down to Silla
verses.literalPt: Levantaram-se os seus servos, fizeram uma conspiração e feriram a Joás na casa de Milo, no caminho que desce para Sila.

verses.original: וְיוֹזָבָ֣ד בֶּן־ שִׁ֠מְעָת וִיהוֹזָבָ֨ד בֶּן־ שֹׁמֵ֤ר׀ עֲבָדָיו֙ הִכֻּ֣הוּ וַיָּמֹ֔ת וַיִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֖יו בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֲמַצְיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·w·zā·ḇāḏ be·nō·ši- šim·ʿāt̲ wî·hō·w·zā·ḇāḏ ben- šō·mêr ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw hik·ku·hū way·yā·mōṯ way·yiq·bə·rū ’ō·ṯōw ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw bə·‘îr dā·wiḏ way·yim·lōḵ ’ă·maṣ·yāh ḇə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: His servants Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer struck him down and he died And they buried him with his fathers in the City of David and his son Amaziah reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: Jozacar, filho de Simeate, e Jozabade, filho de Somer, seus servos, feriram-no, e ele morreu; sepultaram-no com seus pais na cidade de Davi. Em seu lugar, reinou Amazias, seu filho.
